entries.en: You reached the exit in time! Phew.. back to Tom.
entries.translated: Hai raggiunto l'uscita in tempo! Uff... torniamo a Tom.

entries.en: The Dread's torment begins to tear you apart!
entries.translated: Il tormento del Dread comincia a farti a pezzi!
